FIX 1 (research-agent.yml): add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` under `with:` in all three anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 steps (standard Opus, deep Fable, deep Opus fallback). Re-enables scout/coverage-critic deep-tier escalations. github-actions is the only legitimate dispatcher (via escalate-research.js), so allow-list it specifically rather than '*'.

FIX 2 (visual-qa-agent.yml): raise `--max-turns 40` to `--max-turns 80` in the claude_args of the claude-code-action step. The task completes at ~50 turns; the 15-min timeout is not the bottleneck (runs finish in ~5 min), so the turn cap is the only thing turning an otherwise-successful QA run red.
